gog.store_details: GOG sells this bundled with the 2012 BFG Edition remaster, and Heroic installs the two as separate library entries — this one is the classic build (its folder ends '.../DOOM 3'). BFG Edition is a different game and isn't covered here.

audio_fixes.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_fixes.reason: DOOM 3 ships with its EAX sound options off, so there's no reverb.
